versions.changelog:
- Expanded built-in knowledge base to 523+ methods and 24 categories (up from 254+ and 21).
- Added a new comparison table for rendering formulations, including new primitives and compositing techniques.
- Included newly published methods such as SNS (Skew-Normal Splatting) and MGS.
- Updated tables and method descriptions to reflect newly tracked developments.
- Improved classification and indexing across all method types for easier comparison.

**Expanded database and method categories, new primitives, and more detailed comparison support.**

- Increased built-in knowledge from 150+ to 254+ 3DGS methods
- Includes 21 method categories (up from previous)
- Added new primitive type: spatially-varying (SVGS)
- Updated compression and geometry/surface methods with additional recent techniques
- Comparison dimensions and tables reflect latest method variants and features

- Expanded built-in knowledge base: now covers 150+ 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods (up from 105+).
- Added more recent methods in all categories, including foundation, robustness, geometry/surface, compression, language/semantic, and feed-forward approaches.
- Included new comparison entries for methods such as Softmax-GS, LeGS, GETA-3DGS, Luminance-GS++, 2D-SuGaR, IRIS, DiffSoup, ArtifactWorld, GLMap, and NG-GS.
- Updated and extended technical tables for deeper, up-to-date comparisons.
- Version incremented to 1.3.0.

- Increased built-in knowledge base from 104+ to 105+ 3DGS methods.
- Updated description and documentation to reflect the expanded method coverage.
- No code changes; documentation and database adjustment only.

**Initial public release of 3dgs-method-compare.**

- Enables detailed, multi-dimensional comparison of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) variants, covering 104+ methods.
- Generates publication-quality tables analyzing primitives, opacity, color, rendering, performance, and more.
- Includes method database with foundation, compression, geometry, language, feed-forward, and SLAM variants.
- Supports recommendations and trade-offs based on specific research or application scenarios.
- Accepts comparison triggers in both English and Chinese.
